text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
We've got a new project at the Mercurius Foundation.
We purchase foundering resorts at a low price,
improve their business models, and restore them to profitability.
text_block_list.orig_text:
【メルクリウス財団】の新しいビジネスでね、
経営が傾いてるリゾートを安値で買って
業務改善をして、
再生させようって考えてるの。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I've been placed in charge of the project.
It's a lot of work, but I have to do what I can.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私がその計画の責任者なのよ。
大変だけど、
頑張らなくちゃね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: So, let's go and see the resort we've signed a contract with!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
さっそく契約したリゾートへ行ってみましょ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Nice to meet you. I'm Mifuyu from the Mercurius Foundation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はじめまして、
【メルクリウス財団】のミフユといいます。

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh! We've been expecting you.
I really don't know how to thank the Mercurius Foundation enough...
W-we're all counting on you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
お待ちしておりましたっ。
この度は
【メルクリウス財団】になんとお礼を言えばよいか……
ど、
どうぞよろしくお願い致します！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
No need for that. We're looking forward to working with you.
Now, to begin, could you give us a tour of the facilities?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こちらこそ、
今日からしばらく、よろしくお願いしますね。
早速ですけど、
宿の中を案内してもらえますか？

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Of course, most gladly! Come right this way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
もちろんですっ。
こちらへどうぞ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Good... It's pleasant and well-maintained!
The staff members are bright and welcoming, too...
Honestly, it's hard to see why this resort is struggling.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
綺麗でいいところじゃない。
スタッフさんたちも笑顔だし。
このクオリティで経営が傾くなんて、
どうしてかしら？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I suppose the reason must lie elsewhere... I know.
Excuse me! Could I try some of the food you serve to customers?
text_block_list.orig_text:
他に理由があるとしか考えられないわね……
そうだ。
すみませーん。
お客様にお出しする料理を試食させてもらえますか？

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Of course—as you wish! We'll prepare a meal at once.
text_block_list.orig_text:
かしこまりました、
少々お待ち下さいっ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: What kind of dish will it be, I wonder? I can't wait.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どんな料理が出てくるのかしら。
楽しみね。

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Your meal is served, ma'am. Please enjoy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お待たせしました、
こちらです。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Well then, I suppose I'll dig right in.
*munch* *munch* *munch*
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます。
じゃあ早速、
いただくわね。
あむ、
もぐ……
もぐ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...? Hmmm... It's not exactly bad or anything,
but it feels a little lacking...
text_block_list.orig_text:
んん？
　うーん……
美味しくないわけじゃないけど、
物足りないというか……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
For a meal at a resort, it might be best to offer
a higher level of catering.
text_block_list.orig_text:
リゾートの食事なんだから、
もうちょっとレベルの高い食事を提供したいわね。

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. We're aware that our meals could use improvement,
but a major firm is restricting our ingredient supply,
so there's little we can do...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみません。
わたしたちもそうするべきだと思ってはいるのですが……
質の良い食材は大商会に牛耳られてまして、
どうすることも……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: A \"major firm\"?
text_block_list.orig_text: 大商会？

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes. They control the great majority of trade in this region.
Their chairman is a famed gourmet, but he only supplies high-quality
ingredients to those who pay him large monetary tributes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
このあたり一帯を仕切っている商会があるんです。
会長は食通で有名なんですが、
高額な上納金を納めないと、
良い食材を卸してもらえなくて……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I see... In that case, shall we fetch ingredients for you ourselves?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほどね。
なら、
私たちで食材を捕りに行っちゃいましょうか？

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
H-heavens, no!
If the firm caught wind of such a thing, they'd ruin us...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
ダメです！
　連中に見つかったらなにを言われるかっ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I don't think so!
We can't let this firm monopolize a whole market,
and I'm not about to yield to pressure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにをもなにも、
勝手に漁を管理しているなんて見過ごせないし、
それに屈するつもりもないわ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Right—this calls for swift action.
Come with me, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ、
善は急げよ。
{0}くんも行きましょ？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's gather some shellfish in these rock pools!
We're after high-quality clams! Try to pick out ones that look tasty.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よぉし、
まずは岩場で貝類を捕るわよ！
　
狙うは高級貝！
美味しそうなものを選んでね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Oh? That's a very pretty shell...
Wait, could it possibly be a pearl oyster?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？
　綺麗な貝殻じゃない……
って、
もしかしてそれ、
真珠貝？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Incredible... I don't think I've ever seen such a fine specimen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
凄いわね。
こんな綺麗なもの、
初めて見たかも。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
It will make a wonderful souvenir, but it's not edible,
so let's stick to looking for other types of clams, shall we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもお土産にはいいかもだけど、
食用じゃないし、
そういうのを探すのは
また今度にしましょ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Hmm? That fishing boat out there is heading this way...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
　沖の方から漁船が向かってくるわね……

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! What's the big idea, fishing in these waters
without an official license?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こらぁ！
　この海で無断で漁をするとは
いい度胸じゃねぇか！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I see... So this is the firm we heard about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど……
これが大商会の連中ね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure I like your attitude.
The ocean and the resources it provides
are nobody's exclusive property to claim.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ずいぶん横柄な態度ね。
海も、
海で獲れる食材も、
誰のものでもないはずだけど？

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
What did you say?! You must not be from around here.
Somebody needs to teach you how things are done in these parts.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだとぉ～？
　
おめぇ地元のもんじゃねぇな。
ここでのしきたりを教えてやる必要がありそうだ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Hmph. If that's how you want it, I'm quite prepared to—
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふん。
そっちがその気なら、
こっちだって──

text_block_list.name: Firm Employee
text_block_list.text: I-it's here! It's the big one... The Octoking has appeared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
出たぁ！
　あいつが……
『帝王ダコ』が出たぞー！！

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?! All right, men, let's take it down!
Sorry, miss. We'll have to deal with you another time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当か！？
　
よぉしお前ら、
迎え撃つぞ！
嬢ちゃん、
あんたとやり合うのはまた今度だっ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Hey—wait!
Th... they sailed right back out to sea.
What was that all about? An \"Octoking\"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、ちょっと……
って、
沖に戻っていっちゃったけど、
なにがあったのかしら。
帝王ダコって？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I see it now.
That does look like an octopus, but a monstrous one of incredible size.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
あれね。
確かにタコだけど、
でたらめな大きさをした魔物ね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Ah—it's assaulting the boat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
漁船に取り付いた！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure I like their chances.
We should sail out there and see if they need help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このままじゃ危険だわ。
私たちも船を出して
近づいてみましょう！

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
Launch all weapons and offensive magic!
Show the beast we've got firepower!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありったけの装備と魔法で攻撃しろ！
一気に畳み掛けちまえ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
They're equipped with an impressive array of weapons...
But I don't think it's enough.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれだけの武装をよく揃えたものだけど……
あれじゃ勝てないわね。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text: Wha—?! It deflected every shot?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ……！
　すべて弾かれただとぉ！？

text_block_list.name: Firm Employee
text_block_list.text: Waaaaghh! It's attacking in retaliation! Run for it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁああ！
　やつの攻撃が来るぞ！
　逃げろーっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRUOOOGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh...! Their vessel is in tatters!
Let's rescue them before they drown!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁっ……！
　船がめちゃめちゃだわっ！
早く海に落ちた人を助けるわよ！

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text: Dangitall! Who knew the beast was [i]this[/i] powerful?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそぉおっ、
まさかここまで強いとは！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Here—grab on tight! You can leave the rest to us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、つかまって！
　あとは私たちが何とかするから！

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text: What are you saying?! You can't possibly fight that beast alone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに言ってんだ！？
　二人だけで倒せるわけないだろう！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Oh, but I can. With a little help from my companion!
text_block_list.orig_text:
出来るわよ。
私と彼ならね！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
{0}, can you use that power of yours
to increase my strength for a moment?!
choice_data_list: How do I do that again...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お願い。
{0}くんが持ってる不思議な力、
私に貸してちょうだい！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Give me as much as you can!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、
特盛りでお願いね！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! I know you're an amnesiac,
but please don't forget that part!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと！？　
記憶喪失だからってそこまで忘れちゃうの！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I believe you were using your sword... You remember now?
Then let's get back on track. I'm counting on you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その剣を使ってたはずだけど……
思い出した？
じゃあ気を取り直して、
よろしくね！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Hahah, it's such a strange sensation...
When you lend me a little of your strength,
somehow I feel like I can defeat any foe!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
本当に不思議……
{0}くんに強化してもらうと力が溢れて、
どんな敵も目じゃないって気持ちになるわ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Now, I'm coming for you! Octoking!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ行くわよ！
　帝王ダコ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRUOOOOGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Aaahhh?!
I guess its strength is as massive as its body!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃっ！？
大きいだけあってさすがの怪力ね！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Even so, it's no use if its attacks don't hit me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
当たらなきゃどうってことないわ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRUOOOOGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Too slow! Is that really the best you can do?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
遅いっ！
　そんなので攻撃してるつもりっ！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Haaahhh! You're mine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあぁっ！
　ここだぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRUOAAAOGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Whew... That's the end of that.
It was a large monster, but its movements were slow,
so it was no match for the two of our powers combined.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ、
一件落着ね。
大きい魔物だったけど
動きは遅かったし、
{0}くんと私の力なら
どうってことなかったわね。

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it... You guys sure are tough.
Thanks a whole bunch for protecting my crew.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まいったぜ……
あんたら、強ぇんだな。
みんなを守ってくれて、
ありがとうよ。

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
That Octoking's been giving us hell for a long time.
It eats up the fish before they can multiply,
and attacks any fishing boats that stray too close.
text_block_list.orig_text:
昔から帝王ダコには手を焼いてたんだ。
養殖してた魚は食われちまうし、
漁船は襲われてぶっ壊されちまうし。

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
We've made all sorts of attempts up until now
to fish up the big brute, but to no avail. This time we stocked up
on weapons to overpower it, but you saw how that went.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとか釣り上げられねぇかとか、
色々してみたんだが焼け石に水でよ。
これならどうだって武器を買い込んだんだが、
このザマだ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Could it be... All the tributes you've been demanding from the locals
were actually to fund this operation?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして、
この辺りの人たちに要求してた高額な上納金って、
あいつを倒す武器を買うためのものだったの？

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. The ocean's a big place.
Someone's gotta keep it in line, or chaos will rule the waves.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁな。
海は広いんだ。
誰かが管理しねぇと
無法がはびこっちまう。

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
Still, this failure really hurt.
Legendary ingredient or not, I never want to fight that thing again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
けど
今回のは堪えたわ。
いくら幻の食材っつっても、
もうやり合うのは勘弁だ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: \"Legendary ingredient\"?
text_block_list.orig_text: 幻の食材？

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you know? That's what they call the beast.
I tasted a bite of Octoking meat once in my youth,
and it was truly beyond belief...
text_block_list.orig_text:
知らねぇのか？
　あいつはそう呼ばれてんだ。
ワシも若い頃に一度食ったきりなんだが、
その美味さときたら……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea this creature was so sought-after.
Perhaps we've actually found ourselves just the catch the resort needs...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなグルメ御用達の逸品だったんだ。
リゾート再建の目玉食材がゲットできるなんて幸先がいいわね、
私たち。

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
H-hey... I've gotta ask. This octopus... could you let me have it?
I'll apologize for all my rudeness! You can use these waters freely, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なぁ……
お願いだ、
このタコ、
ワシに譲ってくれねぇか？
さっきの失礼は詫びる！
　それと
漁は自由にしてもらって構わねぇから！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm... I don't know about that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うぅ～ん、
どうしようかなぁ～？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Tell you what, Chairman—I [i]will[/i] give you the octopus.
But only if you agree to a few requests.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ。
会長さん、
そのタコ、
お望みどおり差し上げるわ。
私のお願いを聞いてくれたら、
だけど。

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text: R-really?! Thank you kindly! Tell me, what is it you want?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
本当か！
　ありがてぇ！
　それで、
お願いってのはなんだっ？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I want you to become our business partner.
For starters, can you guarantee you'll give us access
to quality ingredients?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちのビジネスパートナーになってちょうだい。
手始めに、
私たちにも質の良い魚を仕入れさせてほしいの。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
And promise me that you won't levy any more excessive tributes.
With the Octoking out of the picture,
that should be no problem, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それと、
もう高い上納金を求めるような振る舞いはやめること。
帝王ダコはもういないんだから、
問題ないわよね？

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
Of course! No trouble whatsoever!
We're in your debt, young miss!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのくらいお安い御用だ！
　恩に着るぜ嬢ちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
And so we reached a rather lucrative agreement!
You shouldn't have any trouble
providing high-quality meals in the future.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってことで、
大商会との交渉は成功。
これでこの宿も、
美味しいお魚を提供できるようになるわ。

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you had quite the adventure. Ah, but...
If we'd kept the Octoking and used it to attract gourmet customers,
our resort would have become popular in no time...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことがあったんですか……
でも
帝王ダコを目玉商品にして
グルメ客を引き込めば、
ここはすぐ人気の宿になったでしょうに……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You think so?
In that scenario, once the octopus meat ran out,
you'd be right back where you started.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうかしら？
　そのやり方じゃ、
タコを食べ尽くしたら
食材探しに逆戻りじゃない。

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
なるほど。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Why stake your fortune on a momentary opportunity
when you could instead forge a business partnership
that will benefit you for years to come?
text_block_list.orig_text:
一時の評判で売上アップを目指すより、
長く続く、
良好な取引関係を作る方がいいんじゃないかしら？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You think so too? I knew you would!
Heheh... You always see right through me, {0}.
It's a little embarrassing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう思った？
　思うわよね！
ふふ、
{0}くんにはお見通しだったかしら。
なんだか照れくさいな。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You only wish you could have tasted the octopus?
Well, of course. It is known as a \"legendary ingredient,\" after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　あのタコ、
食べてみたかった？
そうよね、
幻の食材なんて呼ばれてたわけだし。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Heheh. I thought you might say that, so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ。
そう言うと思って……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! I was rather curious to try it, too, so I kept a sample for myself!
It's only a single tentacle, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃーんっ。
実は私もちょっと興味があって、
持ってきちゃったのよね。
足一本だけだけど。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's cook it up, shall we?
We can all dig in together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇねぇ、
これ焼いてくださーい！
　みなさんも一緒に食べましょ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And so, together with all the resort's staff,
Mifuyu and {0} enjoyed a celebratory banquet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミフユは宿のスタッフたちを囲んで、
ささやかなパーティーを開くのだった。
